source_note: H1 2026 column rebuilt 2026-10-06 from International Breweries Plc unaudited half-year financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026 as reported (businessday.ng 2026-08-03 and nairametrics.com 2026-07-31): Revenue N342.07bn; Cost of sales N200.78bn; Gross profit N141.29bn (gross margin 41.3%); administrative, marketing and distribution expenses N70.5bn; operating profit N69.88bn; finance income N12.0bn against finance costs N7.0bn; Profit before tax N74.79bn; income tax N36.5bn; Profit after tax N38.31bn; EPS N0.23. UNIT: NGN. Cost of Sales and Income Tax are DERIVED (Revenue minus Gross Profit; Profit Before Tax minus Net Profit) so the column ties to the published figures, which the press reported to two decimals in billions; Revenue and Net Profit are the exact figures already in the file. Prior H1 2026 cell set was wrong: Cost of Sales had been back-filled as Revenue minus Net Profit and Gross Profit, Operating Profit and Profit Before Tax had all been set to the Net Profit figure. Identities checked: Revenue minus Cost of Sales = Gross Profit; Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax = Net Profit.
